# betterado_release_definition (Data Source)

Use this data source to read the configuration of an existing Azure DevOps classic
release definition. Useful for referencing an existing pipeline from other
Terraform resources without managing it.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `name` (String)
- `release_definition_id` (Number)
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `path` (String)
- `release_name_format` (String)
